hooks.command: PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)" || { echo 'agent-pingu: no python3 or python on PATH, so lane, phase and autonomy will not reach this session' >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/pingu.py status --quiet

if (Get-Command bash -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { exit 0 }; $py = @('python','py','python3') | ForEach-Object { Get-Command $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $py) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('agent-pingu: no python, py or python3 on PATH, so lane, phase and autonomy will not reach this session'); exit 1 }; & $py.Source "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/pingu.py" status --quiet; exit $LASTEXITCODE

PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)" || { echo 'agent-pingu: no python3 or python on PATH, so the setup guard cannot run; refusing the edit rather than allowing it unchecked' >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/pingu.py guard

if (Get-Command bash -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { exit 0 }; $py = @('python','py','python3') | ForEach-Object { Get-Command $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $py) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('agent-pingu: no python, py or python3 on PATH, so the setup guard cannot run; refusing the edit rather than allowing it unchecked'); exit 2 }; & $py.Source "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/pingu.py" guard; exit $LASTEXITCODE
